knowledge_items.title: Charan Media Platform Architecture
knowledge_items.content: Charan Media is a multi-platform audio/video processing suite built with FastAPI, Python, FFmpeg, and yt-dlp. It provides independent high-speed MP3 audio extraction and MP4 video streaming across YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook, Vimeo and more. Its frontend features clean HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript with modular platform handlers.

knowledge_items.title: Global Capital Cities and Geopolitics
knowledge_items.content: Key world capitals: Japan: Tokyo; United States: Washington, D.C.; India: New Delhi; United Kingdom: London; Germany: Berlin; France: Paris; Australia: Canberra; Brazil: Brasília; Canada: Ottawa; South Africa: Pretoria (administrative), Cape Town (legislative), Bloemfontein (judicial).

knowledge_items.title: Machine Learning & Neural Network Foundations
knowledge_items.content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines dense/sparse vector retrieval with generative large language models like Google Gemini. It ensures factual grounding, eliminates hallucinations, and restricts external context window usage to only relevant chunks.

knowledge_items.title: Business Project Blueprint & Agile Planning
knowledge_items.content: Core project lifecycle: 1. Initiation & Goal Scoping (OKRs); 2. Discovery & Requirement Analysis; 3. Sprint Architecture & Iterative Delivery; 4. Quality Assurance & Stakeholder Review; 5. Production Deployment, Monitoring, and Continuous Feedback.
